req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The schema defines title as max_length=100 (TaskBase). Tests must cover: (1) a valid title well within limit (EP positive), (2) a title of exactly 100 chars (BVA boundary-at-limit), (3) a title of exactly 101 chars (BVA boundary-over-limit, triggers 422), (4) a title of exactly 99 chars (BVA boundary-under-limit, still valid), and (5) a clearly oversized title (NEG negative). Mutation resilience requires asserting exact status codes (201 vs 422), exact boundary values (100, 99, 101), and response body fields to catch constant-bump and operator-flip mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_within_limit
actions: POST /tasks/ with title of 50 characters (well within 100-char limit)
expected: response body contains title field matching submitted value
trace: R-TASK-029: valid title should succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

title_50 = "A" * 50
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_50, "description": None, "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
body = response.json()
assert body["title"] == title_50
assert "id" in body
assert "created_at" in body
assert body["completed"] == False
